D/ DN VALENTINI ANVS PF AVG ; R/ GLORIA ROMANORVM

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Emperor right, Arles mint, Reece period 19, RIC vol. 9 page 64 no. 7(a), issue of 364-367. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right, seen from front. Obverse inscription: DN VALENTINI ANVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right dragging captive and holding labarum. O AE in field. Reverse inscription: GLORIA ROMANORVM. In exergue: CONST. Diameter: 17.9mm, Weight: 2.44gms, die axis: 6
